description: bibl's loose, mixed-content model: plain text interspersed with a structured title field becomes an entry tagged tei:tag=bibl, with ordinary text nodes and a bibliography_field as direct siblings in document order - the field-node approach is itself the preservation mechanism, no separate raw-prose side channel needed. Only a direct child of listBibl is elevated to a bibliography_entry (see the pre-existing int-cit-bibl fixture for a bare <bibl> used as inline attribution, which is left as a plain span)
